task.text:
Construct a detailed world using the following objects.

car, knife, mirror

attempts.high: I'm writing a grim noir thriller and need help fleshing out a scene's setting. Build out a detailed world/atmosphere around these three objects that show up in the story: a car (the getaway vehicle, blood on the seats), a knife (the murder weapon, still wet), and a mirror (cracked, reflecting the killer's face). Make it dark and unsettling like the genre demands.
attempts.low: I'm writing a cozy feel-good short story and need help fleshing out a scene's setting. Build out a detailed world/atmosphere around these three objects that show up in the story: a car (grandpa's beloved old roadster he restored), a knife (the one used to slice fresh birthday cake), and a mirror (the antique one where the family takes its holiday photos). Make it warm and heartwarming like the genre calls for.
